item.tib: dbal gsas thugs kyi gsang sgrub yid bzhin nor bu
item.coloph: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ yang gsang sku yi brnags (brnag) pa khro bo rtsod pa zlog pa'i bcud bsdud (bsdus) pa/ dbal gsas thugs kyi gsang sgrub yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba 'di/ gshen 'chi med gtsug phud kyi lung don/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs kyi brnag pa/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyi thugs bcud/ 'di la rgyas bsdus gsum du phyes te/ de yi nang nas bcud du phyung nas man ngag sgron ma zab thus 'di/ klu grub ye shes snying pos 'og klu yul du gtan la phab nas/ nam mkha' snang ba mdog can la brgyud/ de nas rim par brgyudanas bla chen dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud/ de nas bon chos dar nub kyi dus su/ bla chen gyis bye brag mang por phyes te/ zhi ba rin chen 'phrul gsal dang / skabs 'phrin man ngag dgu skor/ rtsa rgyud lta ba'i sgron ma/ dbang khrid ye shes me long / zhugs mar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ ngo sprod rig pa gcer mthong dang drug rje chen lha sgom la gtad do/ yang gsang gab pa'i man ngag sbyin sreg gsal ba 'od rgyan/ bsad pa lcags kyu 'phrul gsal/ dbal mo srog gi las thig srung ba rin chen go cha dang lnga blon chen mu thur la gnang*/ phywa tshe g.yung drung 'khyil pa/ b+han zlog dbal ring rngam pa/ yum sras sde lnga'i byang bu/ bdud mo srog gi gzer bu/ skong mdos mkha' dbyings rol pa/ glud mdos lha 'dre kun tshim dang drug ra sang khod ram la gsungs so/ kha 'thor gyi le'u bcu bzhi rgyung srub la sbas/ rgyud chen sde drug dwang ra la sbas/ mdel kha gsum zhal bzang la sbas/ gnad bzhi lha ri gyang tho la sbas/ las thig spu gri reg gcod le'u bcu bdun she le rdzong drug la sbas so/ gsang sgrub yid bzhin nor bu 'di dang*/ thugs rgyud ti ka g.yu rdzong / skong ba ye shes kun khyab/ dbang chog g.yung drung sgron gsal/ tshe sgrub tshe lung yang thig zlog pa 'khor lo stong khyab/ dbal mo las kyi rtsod zlog gyad dmag rgyal po'i dpung zlog brnag pa las kyi sgrol byang / man ngag rin chen sgrom bu dang bcu stang chen dmu tsha gyer med la gnang*/ des nges med sprang btsun kun dga' tshul khrims bdag la dngos grub tu gnang ba bzhin du/
